name: Puyang
registryBasis: Henan’s official government-service portal identifies the Puyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the city-level implementing body for real-property transfer registration, with a Puyang administrative service-center location. Henan’s official Tianditu Puyang site is hosted by the Puyang bureau and publishes general city/urban-area maps; no cadastral parcel dataset was listed.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
